Represent Spectro Cloud at industry events and conferences across EMEA. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Why Join Us Shape the future of AI-driven Kubernetes adoption across EMEA enterprises and partner ecosystems. Help enterprises turn hardware investments into production outcomes at scale. Join a fast-growing, innovative company backed by top-tier investors and driven by a team of cloud infrastructure veterans. Collaborate with a global, passionate team of technical and business experts across sales, product, and customer success. review_candidates.title: Sr. Network Edge Engineer (Starlink)
review_candidates.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. SR. NETWORK EDGE ENGINEER (STARLINK) As a Network Edge Engineer at Starlink, you will be instrumental in shaping and implementing the systems, strategies, and partnerships that power Starlink's global connectivity on a worldwide scale. Your role will focus on developing and deploying interconnection infrastructure, including peering, transit, caching, and exchange strategies, to enable Starlink to deliver fast, reliable, and low-latency internet access to millions of users worldwide. In this role, you will drive strategic and analytical efforts to collaborate with partner teams and content providers, designing and implementing solutions that enhance routing efficiency, minimize transit dependency, optimize network performance, and reduce costs. Your responsibilities will span from identifying and securing global peering opportunities to developing automated tools for streamlining interconnection workflows, ultimately ensuring the delivery of high-quality, cost-effective internet services. You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of subsystem engineers, software developers, and operations specialists to ensure seamless integration of the interconnection layer into Starlink's broader infrastructure. By leveraging collaboration, automation, and real-time analysis, you will contribute to the evolution of a network that not only connects the most remote locations on Earth but also extends into orbit, pushing the boundaries of global connectivity. Responsibilities Define and develop projects, milestones, and maintain roadmaps, practicing flexible prioritization and scope management to deliver on program directives Lead the strategic evaluation and analysis of peering and transit opportunities, balancing cost efficiency, performance, and routing control across dozens of global markets Interact with key stakeholders to identify their desired outcomes, take their inputs and deliver improvements to Peering owned processes Build and maintain technical and commercial relationships with global peering partners. Use existing deep industry connections to accelerate execution Design and maintain peering policies, including traffic management, route filtering, redundancy planning, and failover strategies Collaborate with diverse teams across Starlink to ensure seamless integration of peering implementation Lead global IX strategy, including location selection, capacity planning, and onboarding of new interconnects. Work with partner teams to automate and operationalize interconnection workflows, including route validation, telemetry, incident response, and lifecycle tracking. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of experience in network infrastructure (peering, interconnection engineering, backbone architecture) Experience working with: BGP, IP routing & network telemetry Experience with IXPs (Internet exchange point), colocation environments, optical transport, and traffic engineering strategies Preferred Skills And Experience 10+ years of experience designing, building, and optimizing internet interconnects and peering systems Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing legal agreements/requirements Experience with building systems to support and maintain peering/interconnections Extensive professional network within the global ISP, IXP, and content distribution community Experience building real-time monitoring and alerting systems for interconnect performance and routing anomalies Familiarity with Starlink-style distributed systems and the intersection of terrestrial and orbital network layers Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder reporting Additional Requirements Must be willing to do some travel (10-15%) domestically and globally if needed Must be available for on-call rotations Must be willing to work extended hours as needed COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range Level 3: $165,000.00 - $270,000.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. HMRC Chief Digital and Information Office (CDIO) is continuing to evolve its platform model, with greater emphasis on platform ownership, lifecycle management and consistent service delivery across complex technology estates. We are looking for an Associate Platform Owner to join Network Services, supporting the ownership and management of network platforms across LAN, WAN, cloud networking and central infrastructure services. This role will support Platform Owners in understanding user needs, managing platform backlogs, shaping roadmap priorities and delivering continuous improvement across Network Services platforms. Working across LAN, WAN, cloud networking and central infrastructure services, the role helps translate demand, service insight and operational feedback into platform improvements that deliver measurable user and business outcomes. You will work with Platform Owners, internal teams and suppliers to help ensure platform improvements are prioritised, planned and delivered in line with user needs, business value, resilience, security and long-term platform strategy. Job Description Network Services provides critical connectivity and network capabilities that support HMRC colleagues, digital services and operational sites across a large and distributed estate. These platforms include LAN, WAN, cloud networking and central network infrastructure services. The Associate Platform Owner supports the effective ownership and ongoing improvement of these platforms. The role helps connect day-to-day operational insight with longer-term platform health, lifecycle management, roadmap planning, risk management and continuous improvement. You will support Platform Owners in developing platform roadmaps, managing backlogs, gathering user insight and helping prioritise platform investment. You will work across engineering, service, architecture and supplier communities to help ensure platform improvements are aligned to business needs, platform strategy and measurable outcomes. Person specification This is a practical associate platform ownership role, suited to someone with strong organisational skills, curiosity about user needs and an interest in developing product-thinking, prioritisation and platform ownership capability across Network Services. Responsibilities Platform ownership support, roadmap and improvement Support Platform Owners in maintaining platform roadmaps and backlogs, helping ensure work is shaped around user needs, business value, resilience, security and service outcomes. Assist with prioritising platform backlog items, lifecycle work, remediation activity and continuous improvement actions using performance insight, demand signals, risks and dependencies. Support the development and maintenance of platform plans and roadmap views, ensuring priorities, risks, dependencies and operational considerations are visible and managed. Help identify opportunities to improve user experience, service quality, operational control and consistency across Network Services platforms. Platform insight, assets and enablement Maintain asset information, inventories, service records and dependency information so Platform Owners can make informed roadmap, lifecycle and prioritisation decisions. Support lab and test environments used to explore platform change, validate improvements and provide evidence for roadmap and backlog decisions. Gather and analyse platform performance measures, user feedback and service insights to identify improvement opportunities and support roadmap decisions. Help improve platform processes, controls and governance so ownership, prioritisation and decision-making are clear across Network Services platforms. Supplier and stakeholder coordination Work with Platform Owners, suppliers and internal teams to coordinate platform backlog activity, improvement work, maintenance and remediation in line with agreed priorities. Support supplier delivery by tracking actions, progress, risks and outcomes against agreed platform priorities, roadmap commitments and service outcomes. Engage with stakeholders to understand user needs, demand, constraints and priorities that inform platform planning and service improvement activity. Communicate clearly, providing accurate information to support prioritisation, trade-off decisions and effective platform ownership. Risk, dependency and operational awareness Support the identification and coordination of issue resolution, remediation activity and preventative improvement actions that inform backlog and roadmap priorities. Maintain awareness of platform risks, dependencies, lifecycle considerations, user impact and operational constraints across services. Support root cause analysis, problem management and change-related activity where required, ensuring learning is captured and considered in platform improvement plans. Contribute to a culture of platform ownership, accountability, product-thinking and continuous improvement across Network Services. Essential Criteria The successful candidate must be able to clearly demonstrate evidence of the following Essential Criteria: Experience working within an IT, infrastructure or network services environment, supporting platform-based or product-led technology services. Experience supporting platform, product, service or technology improvement initiatives, including planning, prioritisation, backlog management or delivery of change. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage and track multiple activities, actions, risks and priorities. Experience using performance data, service insight, user feedback, asset information or operational information to inform decisions and support improvement activity. Experience working collaboratively across teams, including with suppliers, internal stakeholders and technical teams. Good communication skills, with the ability to clearly present information and support effective decision-making. A proactive approach to identifying issues, understanding user impact, supporting resolution and contributing to continuous improvement. Desirable Criteria Ideally you will also have experience or understanding of: Network technologies or platforms, such as LAN, WAN, cloud networking or central network infrastructure services. Asset, lifecycle, roadmap or configuration management within an IT platform environment. Lab or test environments used to support platform development, assurance or service activity. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 作为客户现场网络运维的核心技术骨干，负责客户中国总部和进40个分支机构的数据中心及园区网络（LAN/WLAN）的故障处理和优化。独立处理复杂网络问题，进行复杂的变更操作，并指导中级工程师工作。本岗位要求对具备扎实的思科、华为、Arista、F5、Bluecat设备实战运维经验，能在客户高可用环境中提供专业服务：  独立负责客户数据中心网络和办公网络的LAN（有线局域网）和WLAN（无线局域网），普通专线、云专线和SD-WAN的复杂/高等级故障处理，进行根因分析并实施解决方案。  主导完成思科、华为、Arista网络设备（交换机、路由器、无线控制器和AP等）的复杂变更操作，包括大规模设备升级、迁移及新功能部署。  在当地支持工程师的协助下（smart hands and eyes）完成远程分支站点的网络，特别是WLAN网络故障的处理。  主导网络架构的调整和性能优化。  指导中级运维工程师进行故障排查和处理，处理中级工程师升级的故障。  主导制定网络故障应急预案和处理流程。  参与网络项目的实施支持，如网络割接等。  主导编写和维护网络技术文档、操作手册和运维流程。  与服务交付经理一起，参与撰写运维报告。 岗位要求 学历与经验  本科及以上学历，计算机、网络工程、通信等相关专业。  具备流利的英语和普通话口语和书面交流能力，以便参加客户全球网络团队会议。  5年以上年大型网络环境运维经验。  熟悉思科、华为、Arista、F5等主流网络厂商产品，拥有华为LAN/WLAN高级配置和故障排查经验者加分。  精通TCP/IP协议栈，深入理解OSI七层模型。  熟悉高级网络协议和架构，对端到端网络架构包括SD-WAN，互联网出口、OSPF，BGP、EVPN/VxLAN、DNS和Cloudflare有扎实的理解。  有一定的公有云（如AWS，阿里云）边缘解决方案和连接的实战经验者加分。  熟悉无线网络（WLAN）的故障处理和优化。  了解网络安全技术和最佳实践，熟悉防火墙、VPN等安全设备。  具备网络性能分析和优化能力。  熟练使用抓包及网络诊断工具进行深度故障分析。  熟悉常见的网络监控和运维工具。  具备网络自动化能力脚本编写能力（Python/Ansible和基于API管理）者加分。  熟悉标准的网络运维流程，熟悉如ServiceNow，Jira，卓豪MSP等工单系统的操作。 认证要求  持有CCIE、HCIE网络认证证书。  拥有PCNSE等安全技术认证证书者加分。  持有ITIL4 基础认证，如有MP高级认证者加分。

Good written and spoken communication skills, great problem-solving skills. Team player and independent in executing work-related jobs. Occasional travelling might be required. Bacha Coffee is an equal opportunity employer. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

review_candidates.description: This is a full-time position working onsite in Des Moines, IA. Candidate must live within a reasonable commute of Des Moines, IA or be able to relocate. Under general supervision, oversee the configuration, administration, management and maintenance of the local and wide area computer network information systems and communication circuits for the enterprise. Participate in on-call rotation for critical support escalation outside of core hours. Responsibilities: Analyze network and system faults, troubleshoot and perform diagnostics on network operating systems and hardware to isolate and resolve communication issues. Configure, install, support and maintain network systems and subsystems, providing recommendations regarding network architectures and solutions in order to ensure efficient and optimum network performance. Assist with analysis, design, and implementation of network architectures. Provide technical support for data and/or telephony communications network infrastructure and respond to inquiries from staff, service providers, vendors and customers. Work as a team member with other technical staff and serve as an expert technical resource across functional teams to ensure consistent knowledge of network architectures and solution capabilities. Conduct research and evaluate network and communication infrastructure technologies and recommend purchases of equipment and services to meet business requirements. Monitor system utilization and associated costs to guide highly complex short and long term information technology investment decisions as related to voice/data network solutions. Assist in producing documentation and technical writing to describe network, system, and security topologies. Implement, support, monitor, and provide advice on network security solutions including firewall, intrusion prevention, host-based security, authentication and encryption systems to ensure internal and external security controls are appropriate and operating as intended. Perform other job-related duties and special projects as required.
